title: Multimedia/Interactive Comic, Localization & Accessible Read-Aloud
objective: Extend digital comics with optional AAI narration/cues, permitted video/animated media, hyperlinks/hotspots, captions/transcripts, speech-to-text/text-to-speech/read-aloud, translation/localization projections and accessibility metadata while keeping static export valid and requiring no network/provider.
acceptance: Optional narration/audio-cue references preserve existing AAI authority and do not create a duplicate audio/narration ledger.
Video or animated media references are capability/rights-filtered governed resources and do not create a parallel ARI asset/provenance ledger.
Hyperlinks and hotspots remain explicit interactive presentation metadata and cannot silently mutate comic, Character, Scene, Dialogue or narrative truth.
Captions, transcripts, speech-to-text, text-to-speech and read-aloud remain explicit accessibility/authoring projections with source lineage and no silent owner-truth mutation.
Translation/localization outputs remain locale-specific projections linked to source text rather than replacements for canonical authored text.
Accessibility metadata and controls are explicit, deterministic and usable without requiring pointer-only or audio-only interaction.
Static export remains valid when multimedia/interactive/localization features are absent, and provider-off/local operation remains a valid core path.
SAA-29 and later industry-interchange/publication behavior remain unauthorized.
boundaries: SAA-28 owns multimedia/interactive presentation, localization projection and accessibility/read-aloud semantics only; AAI, ARI, Dialogue and other source-domain owners remain canonical.
No duplicate audio, asset/provenance, Dialogue, Character, Scene, page/panel/layer or narrative ledger may be created.
No provider/network is mandatory, and interactive metadata cannot itself authorize external network side effects or publication.
Generated captions/transcripts/translations/speech projections cannot silently overwrite canonical source text or owner truth.
SAA-29 remains blocked until verified SAA-28 closeout.
next_action: Await a later explicit owner Continue before governed-starting SAA-28.
